deterministic_checks: env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s guru-template/overlay/verify/tests -p 'test_start_guard.py' -v
env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s guru-template/overlay/verify/tests -p 'test_delivery_policy.py' -v

invariants.rule: The guru-risk-contract-v2 Full Start Guard digest is byte-identical before and after requirements/detail confirmation records are written.
invariants.positive_case: A v2 Full fixture writes confirmation records and retains the original stable digest.
invariants.negative_case: The v2 digest changes solely because confirmation records were added or mutated.

invariants.rule: The v2 stable digest continues to bind schema, chain flags, review runs, and the exact gate-contract bytes.
invariants.positive_case: Review-run or gate-contract drift changes the v2 digest.
invariants.negative_case: Stable planning evidence changes without invalidating the v2 digest.

invariants.rule: Every non-v2 policy executes the legacy Start Guard digest payload byte-for-byte.
invariants.positive_case: A v1 confirmation mutation changes the digest exactly as before.
invariants.negative_case: A non-v2 contract silently selects the new stable payload.
